tools.name: ask-antigravity
tools.description: Execute Google Antigravity CLI (agy) in print mode with model selection, conversation resume, and workspace controls.

prompt.description: Task or question. Reference files by path — agy reads them with its own tools.

model.description: Optional model override (display label from `agy models`). Known: Gemini 3.7 Flash (Low), Gemini 3.7 Flash (Medium), Gemini 3.7 Flash (High), Gemini 3.6 Flash (Low), Gemini 3.6 Flash (Medium), Gemini 3.6 Flash (High), Gemini 3.5 Flash (Low), Gemini 3.5 Flash (Medium), Gemini 3.5 Flash (High), Gemini 3.1 Pro (Low), Gemini 3.1 Pro (High), Claude Sonnet 4.6 (Thinking), Claude Opus 4.6 (Thinking), GPT-OSS 120B (Medium). If omitted, uses your Antigravity CLI default.

workingDir.description: Working directory for execution (alias of cd)

sessionId.description: Internal session ID for conversation continuity (workspace-isolated).

conversationId.description: Native Antigravity conversation ID to resume (--conversation). Overrides sessionId lookup.

resetSession.description: Clear session context before execution. Starts fresh conversation.

continueLatest.description: Use --continue to resume the most recent conversation.

responseMode.description: Response verbosity: "clean" returns only the final answer (default), "full" includes the stderr execution log.

dryRun.description: Return the resolved CLI argv as JSON without spawning agy.

tools.name: batch-antigravity
tools.description: Delegate multiple atomic tasks to Antigravity for batch processing. Ideal for repetitive operations, mass refactoring, and automated transformations.

tasks.description: Array of atomic tasks to delegate to Antigravity

model.description: Optional model override applied to every task. Known: Gemini 3.7 Flash (Low), Gemini 3.7 Flash (Medium), Gemini 3.7 Flash (High), Gemini 3.6 Flash (Low), Gemini 3.6 Flash (Medium), Gemini 3.6 Flash (High), Gemini 3.5 Flash (Low), Gemini 3.5 Flash (Medium), Gemini 3.5 Flash (High), Gemini 3.1 Pro (Low), Gemini 3.1 Pro (High), Claude Sonnet 4.6 (Thinking), Claude Opus 4.6 (Thinking), GPT-OSS 120B (Medium).

skipPermissions.description: --dangerously-skip-permissions (typical for batch jobs — print mode can't answer prompts)

concurrency.description: Maximum parallel agy processes when parallel=true. Default: min(task count, 4)

stopOnError.description: Stop execution if any task fails

timeout.description: Maximum execution time per task in milliseconds

tools.name: review-changes
tools.description: Run a code review against the current repository using Antigravity (collects git diff + structured review prompt).

prompt.description: Custom review instructions or focus areas (optional)

uncommitted.description: Review staged + unstaged + untracked changes (working tree)

base.description: Review changes against a specific base branch (e.g., "main", "develop")

commit.description: Review changes introduced by a specific commit SHA

title.description: Optional title for the review summary

model.description: Optional model override. Known: Gemini 3.7 Flash (Low), Gemini 3.7 Flash (Medium), Gemini 3.7 Flash (High), Gemini 3.6 Flash (Low), Gemini 3.6 Flash (Medium), Gemini 3.6 Flash (High), Gemini 3.5 Flash (Low), Gemini 3.5 Flash (Medium), Gemini 3.5 Flash (High), Gemini 3.1 Pro (Low), Gemini 3.1 Pro (High), Claude Sonnet 4.6 (Thinking), Claude Opus 4.6 (Thinking), GPT-OSS 120B (Medium). If omitted, uses your Antigravity CLI default.

workingDir.description: Working directory to run the review in

tools.name: plan-antigravity
tools.description: Generate a structured implementation plan using Antigravity. Use BEFORE coding to get steps, files-to-touch, risks, and open questions. Distinct from ask-antigravity: enforces a plan-only system prompt and parses structured output.

goal.description: What you want planned (a feature, refactor, investigation).

contextFiles.description: Paths/globs to reference in the prompt.

constraints.description: Hard constraints (must-not-touch areas, style rules, deadlines).

acceptance.description: Acceptance criteria the plan must satisfy.

format.description: Output shape. json (default) returns structured steps/risks; markdown returns a checklist.

tools.name: brainstorm
tools.description: Generate creative ideas using structured frameworks with domain context and feasibility analysis.

model.description: Optional model override. Known: Gemini 3.7 Flash (Low), Gemini 3.7 Flash (Medium), Gemini 3.7 Flash (High), Gemini 3.6 Flash (Low), Gemini 3.6 Flash (Medium), Gemini 3.6 Flash (High), Gemini 3.5 Flash (Low), Gemini 3.5 Flash (Medium), Gemini 3.5 Flash (High), Gemini 3.1 Pro (Low), Gemini 3.1 Pro (High), Claude Sonnet 4.6 (Thinking), Claude Opus 4.6 (Thinking), GPT-OSS 120B (Medium). If omitted, uses your Antigravity CLI default.

methodology.description: Framework: divergent, convergent, scamper, design-thinking, lateral, auto (default)

domain.description: Domain: software, business, creative, research, product, marketing, etc.

constraints.description: Limitations: budget, time, technical, legal, etc.

tools.name: bg-antigravity
tools.description: Run Antigravity CLI as a detached background task. Subactions: start (returns taskId), status, tail (log output), stop, remove, list. Use for long-running autonomous work — the MCP call returns immediately and you poll status later.

label.description: Human-readable label to identify this task later.

model.description: Optional model override. Known: Gemini 3.7 Flash (Low), Gemini 3.7 Flash (Medium), Gemini 3.7 Flash (High), Gemini 3.6 Flash (Low), Gemini 3.6 Flash (Medium), Gemini 3.6 Flash (High), Gemini 3.5 Flash (Low), Gemini 3.5 Flash (Medium), Gemini 3.5 Flash (High), Gemini 3.1 Pro (Low), Gemini 3.1 Pro (High), Claude Sonnet 4.6 (Thinking), Claude Opus 4.6 (Thinking), GPT-OSS 120B (Medium).

skipPermissions.description: --dangerously-skip-permissions (default for bg tasks: true — print mode can't answer permission prompts).

lines.description: Lines to return from log tail.

tools.name: digest-antigravity
tools.description: Ingest many files at once and answer a focused question. Uses Antigravity's large model context (Gemini ~1M tokens) to swallow whole modules / docs that don't fit in the caller's context. Walks directories, filters by extension, truncates oversized files, caps total payload. Returns a concentrated brief.

question.description: Focused question to answer using the provided files (e.g., "explain auth flow", "find dead code").

paths.description: Files or directories to ingest. Directories are walked. Globs are NOT expanded — pass concrete paths.

extensions.description: Filter by extensions when walking dirs (e.g., [".ts", ".tsx"]). Default: all text-like files.

exclude.description: Substrings to exclude from paths (matched against relative path). Default: node_modules, .git, dist, build.

maxBytesPerFile.description: Truncate any single file above this size. Default: 200 KB.

maxTotalBytes.description: Stop adding files once the total payload exceeds this. Gemini models have ~1M-token contexts; 8 MB default leaves headroom.

shape.description: summary: 1-paragraph; detailed: structured deep-dive; qa: focused answer to the question.

tools.name: delegate-antigravity
tools.description: Delegate an implementation task to Antigravity in an isolated git worktree. The agent runs autonomously (--dangerously-skip-permissions) on a fresh branch, optionally looping against a test command. Returns a taskId; later 'collect' to grab the diff. Safe: changes are sandboxed, caller reviews & applies.

action.description: start: spawn delegated task; status: check progress; collect: stop + return diff + cleanup option.

task.description: What Antigravity should accomplish (required for action=start).

acceptanceCriteria.description: Bullet list of criteria the implementation must satisfy.

baseBranch.description: Branch/commit to base the worktree on (default: current HEAD of repo).

branchName.description: Name for the new branch in the worktree. Default: agy/<random>.

autoTest.description: Shell command Antigravity should run after editing to validate (e.g., "npm test"). If passed, the agent is told to loop until it passes.

cleanup.description: On collect: also run `git worktree remove` after grabbing the diff.

tools.name: list-sessions
tools.description: List active conversation sessions with metadata, or manage them (delete/clear)

action.description: Action: list (default), delete (single session), clear (all sessions)

tools.name: health
tools.description: Check Antigravity CLI installation, authentication, available models, and session health

sessionId.description: Optional session ID to check specific session health

tools.name: list-models
tools.description: List model labels currently available to Antigravity CLI (`agy models`). Use these exact labels for the `model` parameter.

tools.name: metrics
tools.description: Expose Prometheus-formatted metrics for Antigravity MCP server
